name: UAL 221 颠簸 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 221, you are maintaining 11,300 meters, over JTN, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 221，正保持 11,300 米，飞越 JTN，应答机 5536，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, maintaining 2300 meters, over JTN, squawking 5536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，正保持 2300 米，飞越 JTN，应答机 5536。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, fly direct to TOL, maintain mach decimal 83 due separation.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，直飞 TOL，因间隔需要保持 Mach 0.83。
cards.referenceText: fly direct to TOL, maintain mach decimal eight tree, UAL 221.

cards.audioText: you are encountering severe turbulence at 11,300 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 11,300 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制并核实是否有任何更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 11 thoudand 300 meters, is higher level available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，我们在 11300 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 221, 13100m is available now, say your intention.
B: tell the controller you are unable to accept 13100m because of performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 221，13100m 当前可用，请说明你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员，由于性能原因你无法接受 13100m。
cards.referenceText: negative, we are unable to accept 4001 hudnred due performance, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，由于性能原因，我们无法接受 4001 hudnred，UAL 221。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 221, maintain present speed, expect higher level after IKUBA.
B: tell the controller you are unable to maintain the speed due turbulence and ask to maintain mach decimal 82.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 221，保持当前速度，预计飞越 IKUBA 后可使用更高高度。
B： 告诉管制员由于颠簸你无法保持该速度，并请求保持 Mach 0.82。
cards.referenceText: negative mach decimal eight tree due turbulence, request maintain decimal eight two, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，因颠簸无法保持 Mach 0.83，请求保持 Mach 0.82，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: now you are over IKUBA, maintaining 9200m, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你飞越 IKUBA，保持 9200m，联系武汉管制并请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, over IKUBA, maintaining 9200, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，飞越 IKUBA，保持 9200，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400m.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升至并保持 10400m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 1400 meters, UAL 221.

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然有 1 名旅客心脏病发作，联系武汉管制，请求下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, request descent to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，1 名旅客心脏病发作，请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, maintain 10400m due airspace congestion, reduce speed to mach decimal 75.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，因空域拥堵保持 10400m，将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 1400, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 221.

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, descend to 6600m, level at XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，下降至 6600m，在 XSH 改平。
cards.referenceText: descend to 6600, level at XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600，在 XSH 改平，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, track direct to XSH, follow ZF-3A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-3A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: track direct to XSH, follow ZF tree A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36 right, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-3A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600m, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 ZF 上空，保持 6600m，已收到 O 情报，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 221, over ZF, maintaining 6600, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 221，位于 ZF 上空，保持 6600，O 情报。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is P, descend and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前情报为 P，下降并保持 4200m。
cards.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: P 情报，下降至并保持 4200，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: UAL 221, turn right heading 330, descend to 900m, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 221，右转航向 330，下降至 900m，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，UAL 221。
